content: Sounkohwa Mwersuwed
Sises ketin mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Ohl kepwehpwe men mie, me nah sounkohwa men adsuwedla, dene me peidlakid ong eh kohwa kepwe kan.
E ahpw ekerodo nah sounkohwao oh idek, ‘Ia duwen rohng pwoatet duwen kowe? Wehkada mahs omw kohwahn, pwe ke solahr kak wia ei sounkohwa.’
Sounkohwao ahpw mengimengloalki, ‘Dahme I pahn wiaht? Pwe ei mwohnsapwo pahn ketikihsang ie ei kohwa doadoahket. I sohte kakohng doadoahk en pwehl, I namenengki pekipekseli.
Eri, soh pwe I ese dahme I pahn wia, pwe aramas akan en kasamwoielong nan imwarail kan, ni ei pahn lekdeksang nan ei kohwa.’
Ih eri ekerodo aramas koaros me pweipwand ong eh mwohnsapwo. E ahpw idek rehn me kohdo mahso, ‘Ia uwen omw pweipwand ong mwohnsapwo?’
A e sapeng, nda, ‘Kalon en lehn olip epwiki.’ A e ndahng, ‘Ale noumw pwuhken, mwohndi oh ntingihedi me limeisekte.’
A e pil idek rehn emen, ‘A kowe, ia uwen omw pweipwand?’ A e sapeng, nda, ‘Edin pilawa kid.’ A e ndahng, ‘Ale noumw pwuhken, mwohndi oh ntingihedi me welipwikihte.’

Ni mwohnsapwo eh mwahngihada met, e ahpw kapingahla loalokong suwed en sounkohwao; pwe aramas akan me kisehn sampah, re me kin loalokong ni mehkan me pid pein irail laudsang me kisehn marain kan ni mehkan me pid ar mour soutuk.”

Sises eri pil mahsanih, “Eri, I ndaiong kumwail, kumwail en doadoahngkihong aramas teikan amwail dipwisoun sampah kan, pwe re en wiahla kompoakepamwail; pwe ni amwail dipwisou eh pahn sohrala, Koht pahn ketin kasamwolong kumwail nan dehu soutuk kan.
Me kin loalopwoat ni mehkot tikitik, e pahn pil loalopwoat ni mehkot laud; oh me kin keseulikilik ni mehkot tikitik, e pahn pil keseulikilik ni mehkot laud.
Eri, ma kumwail sohte pahn loalopwoat ni paien sampah kan, a ihs me pahn liki ong kumwail ni pai mehlel kan en powe?
Oh ma kumwail me keseulikilik ni doadoahk en kohwahki ong emen eh dipwisou, a ihs me pahn kihong kumwail mehkot pwe en wia uhdahn amwail?
“Sohte ladu men kak papah soumas riemen: pwe e pahn kailongki emen oh poakohng meteio; e pahn kesempwalki emen, oh mwamwahlki meteio. Eri, kumwail sohte kak papah Koht oh dipwisoun sampah.”
Sapwellimen Sises Mahsen kei
Parisi ko iang rongorong mepwukat koaros, re ahpw kin kepikepitki Sises, pwehki ar kesempwalki mwohni.

Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kin akupwungki pein kumwail mwohn mesen aramas akan, a Koht ketin mwahngih dahme audepen nan kapehdomwail kan. Pwe me kin kalap kesempwal rehn aramas akan, kin wiahla mehkot mwahl mwohn silangin Koht.

“Manaman en Kosonned en Moses oh padahk en soukohp ako mieier sang kawao kohdo lel ni mwehin Sohn Sounpapidais; a sang ni ahnsowo Rongamwahu duwen Wehin Koht lolohkseli oh aramas koaros kin nannantihong re en pedolong nan Wehin Koht.”
Ahpw me mengei ong nanleng oh sampah en sohrala sang kisin mesen nting kis en Kosonnedo en sohrala.
“Mehmen me kin mweisang uhdahn eh pwoud oh pwoudikihda emen lih tohrohr, kin wiahda dipen kamwahl; oh mehmen me kin pwoudikihda lih me eh pwoud keselahr, e pil wiahda dipen kamwahl.”
Ohl Kepwehpwe men oh Lasarus
“Ahnsou ehu ohl kepwehpwe men mie, me kin likawih likou melengileng weitahta oh kaselel, oh kin kamakamadipw rahn koaros.
Pil mie ohl semwehmwe men, ede Lasarus, diren kens ni paliwere, me kin wisikiong ni wenihmwen imwen ohl kepwehpweo;
pwe e kin men tungoale mweremwer en kisin mwenge me kin pwupwudi sang pohn en ohl kepwehpweo eh tehpel. Kidi kan pil kin keiong mpe oh tamwetamwe eh kens kan.
Kedekedeo, ohl semwehmweo ahpw mehla, tohnleng kan ahpw wahdalahng nanleng mpen Eipraam. Me kepwehpweo pil mehla, oh seridi.
Nan eh weiweirek laud rehn me lekdeklahr akan,
e ahpw kilengdahla kilangada Eipraam wasa doh iangahki Lasarus.

Ih eri likwerlahng Eipraam, patohwan, ‘Semei Eipraam, komw ketin kupwure ie! Komw ketin kadarodo mahs Lasarus pwe en kaduh sendin peh nan pihl oh kalamwurehki loweiet, pwe I mwasingkilahr kowahlap kisiniei wet.’

Eipraam ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, ‘Kompoakepahi, tamanda me ke aleier omw pai koaros ni omw mour nin sampah, a Lasarus ale soahng suwed koaros; ihme e nsensenamwahuki ahnsou wet, a kowe wie weiweirengki.
A pil ehu, wahu kalaimwun ehu mie nanpwungatail; sohte mehmen reht kak sipalowohng rehmwail, pil sohte mehmen rehmwail kak sipalodohng reht.’
Ohl kepwehpweo ahpw sapeng, nda, ‘Eri, I peki rehmwi, semei, komw poaronelahng Lasarus mahs ni imwen ei pahpao nin sampah,
rehn riei me limmeno. Komw poaronehla pwe en kolahng kehsehkin irail wasaht, pwe re dehr pil leledohng nan wasahn weirek wet.’
Eipraam mahsanihalahng, ‘Pwuken Moses oh soukohp ako mie rehn riomw ko pwe en kehsehkin irail soahng koaros. Re en rong dahme Moses oh soukohp ko kin mahsanih.’
Ohl kepwehpweo ahpw sapeng, patohwan, ‘Maing, semei Eipraam, soahng wet sohte itar! Ma emen sang rehn me melahr akan pahn pwarala rehrail, eri, re pahn koluhla oh wiliakapwala.’
Eipraam sapeng, mahsanih, ‘Ma re sohte rong Moses oh soukohp ako, re pil sohte pahn kamehlele emen me pahn pwarala sang rehn me melahr akan.”
